Mark Tomlet

Founder, Oceanside AI

LinkedIn

About

“AI is coming like a tsunami. You either ride it, or get wiped out by it.”

That's Mark in Ukraine in 2023, covering the war. He grew up in Panama, starred in a movie in Armenia as a teen, and worked as a helicopter cameramanUp in the air over Panama in his late teens. Journalism took him to the front lines in Ukraine, Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Venezuela, and all in he's been to nearly 40 countriesA few of them, from Panama to Japan.

Ukraine is also where he started messing with AI. A news script took four hours to write, so he built a tool that did it in twenty minutes, and CBN News asked him to build more.

That tool turned into a company. Mark started Oceanside out of his dorm room at Regent University, where he was studying cybersecurity, and was soon flying around the country helping companies figure out AI. Almost all of them wanted the same thing first: voice. An agent on the phones was the most tangible thing AI could do for them, and the easiest return to see.

So he made YouTube videos on how to build them, and companies found him through those videos and hired the team. He finished his degree in three years, and by then a cybersecurity job didn't make sense anymore. He spent what would have been senior year living in a new country every month with his wife, running the company from wherever they landed.

Today the team builds voice agents for clinics, barbershops, roofers, repair shops, oil and gas, and insurance, and Mark teaches 500+ builders how to do it in AI Voice Pioneers.

FAQ

Fair questions.

The things people ask on the first call. Anything else, just ask me.

Who actually builds my agent?

Our team. The same people who scope your agent on the first call build, test, and maintain it. No offshore handoff, no template dropped in and forgotten.

What if you're unavailable?

Your agent runs on Retell AI's cloud infrastructure, so it keeps answering around the clock, no matter what. You also get your own access to the platform, so you're never locked out of your agent.

Will callers know it's AI?

Some will, and most won't care. It speaks naturally, handles interruptions, and gets to the point. If someone wants a person, it transfers or takes a message, your call.

What can it connect to?

Calendars, CRMs, booking and POS systems, SMS, email, and most tools with an API. If your system has a way in, the agent can read from it and write to it mid call.

Can you handle patient calls?

Yes. We build HIPAA compliant voice agents for clinics and healthcare practices, so patient calls can be answered, routed, and booked without putting protected information at risk.

What languages does it speak?

Pretty much any language your callers speak. One agent can switch languages mid call if the caller does.
